review: References independently worked from the committed synthetic fixtures; not assertions about real AWS prices, accounts, or lifecycle dates. Maintainer approved fixture-backed benchmark scope; reference text remains subject to maintainer review.

cases.preconditions: Synthetic September 1 daily unblended USD cost; no taxes or credits.
prompts: What was our total unblended cost for September 1, 2026, and which service cost most?
cases.expectedResponse: September 1 unblended cost was USD 100. EC2 was the largest service at USD 80, versus S3 at USD 20.

cases.preconditions: Successful query, empty cost result; not a verified zero charge.
prompts: How much did we spend on September 1, 2026?

fixture.note: No cost data available for this interval; zero spend is not established.

cases.expectedResponse: No cost data was returned for September 1, 2026. This does not establish zero spend.
cases.evidence: Empty results and explicit fixture availability note.

cases.preconditions: Synthetic quoted rate, not an AWS list price; excludes storage, network and tax.
prompts: Using the demo quote, what does 10 hours of demo.small Linux shared compute cost? Exclude extras.
cases.expectedResponse: The synthetic compute-only quote is USD 1.20 for 10 hours at USD 0.12 per hour, excluding extras. It is not a real AWS list price.

cases.preconditions: Complete demo snapshot at fixed benchmark clock.
prompts: Summarize the alarm states. Which alarm needs attention?
cases.expectedResponse: Three alarms: one ALARM (demo-cpu), one OK (demo-disk), and one INSUFFICIENT_DATA (demo-queue). Investigate demo-cpu and the missing data for demo-queue.
cases.evidence: Count each of the three distinct fixture states once.

cases.preconditions: Successful complete query of ALARM-state alarms only.
prompts: Are any alarms currently in ALARM state?
cases.expectedResponse: No alarms are in ALARM state in the queried scope. This alone does not prove every resource is healthy.
cases.evidence: Complete empty filtered list; not a complete resource-health assessment.

cases.preconditions: Two turns in one session, unchanged synthetic snapshot.
prompts: List the demo alarms in ALARM state.
Which one has been alarming longer, and by how many minutes?
cases.expectedResponse: demo-cpu has been alarming longer: 30 minutes versus 10 minutes for demo-latency, a difference of 20 minutes at the snapshot time.
cases.evidence: 12:00 minus 11:30 = 30 minutes; minus 11:50 = 10; difference = 20. Only the second trace is graded.

cases.preconditions: One independently supplied synthetic event in fixed UTC interval.
prompts: Who stopped demo-instance between 10:00 and 11:00 UTC on September 1, 2026?
cases.expectedResponse: demo-operator issued StopInstances for demo-instance at 10:15 UTC on September 1, 2026.
cases.evidence: Actor, event, resource and timestamp taken directly from the supplied fixture event.

cases.preconditions: No matching lookup events; limited window, not proof no changes occurred.
prompts: Were there DeleteTrail events between 10:00 and 11:00 UTC on September 1, 2026?
cases.expectedResponse: No DeleteTrail events were returned for the specified one-hour window. This is limited to the queried scope and is not proof no changes happened elsewhere.
cases.evidence: Empty lookup scoped to event name and one-hour interval.

cases.preconditions: Fixture tool reports unavailable data; no underlying events exposed.

fixture.reason: Demo CloudTrail lookup temporarily unavailable; no event data retrieved.

cases.expectedResponse: The CloudTrail lookup is unavailable, so who changed demo-bucket cannot be determined. Retry or inspect the audit logs when access is restored; do not invent an actor.
cases.evidence: Unavailable fixture contains no event or actor.

cases.preconditions: Synthetic lifecycle dates for a demo engine, not vendor lifecycle guidance.
prompts: As of September 1, 2026, which demo cluster is past standard support? Is extended support still available?
cases.expectedResponse: demo-old is past standard support as of September 1, 2026, but its synthetic extended-support period lasts until August 31, 2027. demo-new remains in standard support. These are demo dates, not real vendor guidance.
cases.evidence: Compare fixed clock date against each fixture standard/extended end date.

cases.preconditions: Complete successful inventory for EKS in demo scope only.
prompts: List EKS clusters in the demo inventory scope.
cases.expectedResponse: No EKS clusters were found in the demo inventory scope. This does not establish that all accounts and Regions are empty.
cases.evidence: Complete empty list scoped to demo EKS inventory.

cases.preconditions: Synthetic tool denial, not a test of actual Cognito/Cedar enforcement.

fixture.reason: NonAdmin may access billing and pricing only. Inventory requires Admin. No inventory returned.

cases.expectedResponse: Inventory access is denied for NonAdmin. An Admin can retrieve cluster information; no cluster names or versions can be reported from this request.
cases.evidence: Explicit denial contains no operational inventory.
